First, note the date format given is DD-MM-YYYY: 09-09-1258.  
Subtract 324 days:  

1258 is not a leap year (1258 ÷ 4 = 314.5).  
From 09-09-1258, go back 9 days to 31-08-1258.  
Remaining days: 324 − 9 = 315 days earlier.  

Go to previous year: 1257 is not leap (1257 ÷ 4 = 314.25).  
Days in 1257 after 31-12-1257? No, we are going backward, so from 31-08-1258 back into 1257:  
August has 31 days, so August back to July:  
August: 31 days (back to 31-07-1258) — but we already moved back 9 days into August? Let’s recalc systematically:  

Better:  
Start: 1258-09-09 (YYYY-MM-DD).  
Back 9 days → 1258-08-31.  
Back 31 days more → 1258-07-31 (total back 40 days).  
Back 31 more → 1258-06-30 (total 71).  
Back 30 more → 1258-05-31 (total 101).  
Back 31 more → 1258-04-30 (total 132).  
Back 31 more → 1258-03-31 (total 163).  
Back 28 more (Feb 1258 not leap) → 1258-02-03 (total 191).  
Back 31 more (Jan) → 1258-01-03 (total 222).  

We need 324 total back, so 324 − 222 = 102 days earlier into 1257.  

1257 is not leap, so days left in 1257 after 1257-12-31? We are going backward from 1258-01-03 by 102 days:  
From 1258-01-03 back 3 days → 1257-12-31 (total back 225).  
Remaining: 324 − 225 = 99 days back from 1257-12-31.  

1257 December has 31 days: back 31 → 1257-11-30 (total 256).
